title: Docker & DevOps Trends - November 2025
summary: Analysis of November 2025 Docker/DevOps trends reveals moderate applicability for Chained. Key insights: docker-compose to cloud-native migration pain points, IDE-integrated development workflows, and validation that Cloud Run remains optimal for our scale. No urgent action required, but valuable ecosystem awareness.

key_insights.description: Industry-wide pain point: developers use docker-compose for local development but face manual, error-prone translation to cloud-native production (Kubernetes, Cloud Run, ECS). GitHub Copilot feature request signals demand for automated conversion tools.

impact.problem: Configuration drift between docker-compose (local) and Terraform (production)
impact.current_mitigation: Manual sync, small scale makes it manageable
impact.priority: MEDIUM - Document and monitor, don't build custom solution yet

action_items: Audit current docker-compose vs Terraform configuration drift
Monitor GitHub Copilot's docker-compose import feature development
Re-evaluate automation when configuration drift becomes problematic

key_insights.description: Modern IDEs (Cursor, enhanced VS Code) are integrating container development, cloud deployment, and monitoring into single interface. 'Inside Cursor, becoming full stack' trend signals unified developer experience evolution.

impact.current_setup: VS Code + GitHub Copilot + separate Docker/gcloud CLI
impact.adoption_barrier: Learning curve, unproven ROI for small team
impact.priority: LOW - Monitor but don't adopt yet

action_items: Document current developer workflow fragmentation (4-5 tools)
Optionally: trial Cursor IDE for 1 week (non-binding evaluation)
Enhance VS Code with Docker + Cloud Code extensions
Re-evaluate Cursor in 6-12 months when more mature

key_insights.insight: Cloud Run Serverless Containers Validated as Sweet Spot
key_insights.description: Ongoing containers vs serverless debate confirms Cloud Run (serverless containers) is optimal for Chained's scale: container flexibility + serverless benefits (auto-scale, pay-per-use, zero management) without Kubernetes complexity.
sources: GCP Cloud Run use case patterns

impact.validation: Current architecture is optimal for our use case
impact.chained_fit: 13 services, sporadic traffic, AI/ML dependencies, small team
trigger_points_for_change: Monthly cost >$1,000 → Consider GCE reserved instances

action_items: Document Cloud Run architecture decision rationale
Create decision tree for future architecture changes
Monitor monthly costs and service count

patterns.name: Docker-Compose to Cloud-Native Translation Gap
patterns.description: Developers use docker-compose for local development but face manual, error-prone translation to cloud-native production services. Configuration drift and deployment friction result.
patterns.industry_trend: Emerging automation tools (GitHub Copilot import, Kompose for K8s)
current_solutions: Separate local and prod configs (drift risk)
patterns.chained_status: We have this gap but manage manually at small scale
patterns.recommendation: Document current process, monitor tool maturity, automate when ROI clear

patterns.name: IDE-Integrated Full-Stack Container Development
patterns.description: Modern IDEs integrating code editing, container management, cloud deployment, and production monitoring into unified interface. Reduces context switching, accelerates development.
patterns.trend: Growing adoption (Cursor IDE, VS Code extensions)
patterns.current_setup: VS Code + GitHub Copilot works well for small team
patterns.recommendation: Monitor Cursor maturity, enhance VS Code extensions, re-evaluate in 6-12 months

patterns.name: Cloud Run as Serverless Container Sweet Spot
patterns.description: Cloud Run (serverless containers) provides optimal balance for small-to-medium teams: container flexibility + serverless benefits without Kubernetes complexity.
patterns.use_case: AI/ML workloads with sporadic traffic, complex dependencies, small DevOps team

when_to_migrate_from_cloud_run.to_gke: Service count >50, complex orchestration needs, dedicated DevOps team
when_to_migrate_from_cloud_run.to_cloud_functions: Never (Cloud Run is superset of Functions capabilities)

patterns.validation: Chained's 13 Cloud Run services, sporadic learning missions, $200-500/month cost validate this choice
patterns.recommendation: Continue with Cloud Run, document decision rationale, monitor trigger points
